description: Less storage can prevent you from installing new apps, downloading media, or saving photos and videos on your phone. Clearing unnecessary files will free up more room and improve the device's performance. In this article, we discuss different ways you can free up storage on your Android smartphone.
title: How to Free Up Storage on an Android Phone

description: Picking a username for a social media account can feel like a decision you will stick with forever, especially if it's your first time doing so. A few years later, that random nickname, string of numbers, or overly enthusiastic handle from your teenage years may not seem quite as clever. In such instances, you may also want to change your username after switching to a professional account, rebranding a business, or simply finding a handle that better reflects who you are now. Well, if it is Instagram is the platform you’re on, then there’s a way to change your username without creating a new account.
title: How to Change Instagram Username: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Google launched passkeys in 2023 as an alternative to passwords. They offer a convenient way to sign in with your fingerprint, face scan, or screen lock. Google designed Passkeys to protect against phishing and other attacks. In this article, we explain how to set up a passkey for a Google Account.
title: How to Turn on Passkeys for Google Account: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: Several smartphones under Rs. 75,000 offer hardware suited to demanding mobile games, including high-end processors, fast displays and large batteries. The iQOO 15 and OnePlus 15R feature displays with refresh rates of up to 144Hz and 165Hz, respectively, while the Motorola Edge 70 Max adds 360Hz touch sampling. The Poco X8 Pro Max stands out with its 9,000mAh battery and dedicated cooling system. The Vivo X200T rounds out the list with the Dimensity 9400+ chipset and a 120Hz AMOLED display.
title: Best Gaming Phones Under Rs 75,000 in India: iQOO 15, OnePlus 15R and More

description: An iPhone is a significant investment. Apple’s flagship models, especially, often tend to cost upwards of one lakh in India. Having such an expensive device in your pocket all day carries certain risks, too. Thus, knowing whether it is still covered by Apple's warranty can be useful when the device develops a hardware issue or needs servicing. Checking the warranty status can also be helpful when buying a used iPhone, as it lets you verify whether the device still has active coverage. Fortunately, Apple provides more than one way to check this information.
title: How to Check iPhone Warranty Status: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: WhatsApp is capable of automatically downloading media files for users, including photos, videos, audio files, and documents. However, this feature can cause the storage of you device to fill up quickly if you leave it unchecked. This forces users to individually delete media files from their phones. However, you can also choose to stop WhatsApp from automatically downloading photos and videos from the settings menu.
title: How to Stop WhatsApp From Automatically Downloading Photos and Videos: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: The under-Rs. 50,000 smartphone segment has few options with wireless charging. Our picks include the Motorola Edge 70 Pro+, Reno 14 Pro, and Samsung Galaxy S24 FE, among others. They offer high refresh-rate displays, strong processors, versatile cameras, and large batteries.
title: Best Phones Under Rs. 50,000 With Wireless Charging in India: Motorola Edge 70 Pro+, Google Pixel 10a, More
